client_name: Great Lakes Family Dental (42 North Dental)
ideal_character_range: 1300 to 1450 characters when detailed content is needed
link_rules: If topic is service/treatment-related, link that specific page. Otherwise use location page URLs.

title_rules.structure: Topic / Benefit / Question + Brand Name + Location
title_rules.core_rule: Title must NEVER start with the brand name. Lead with the topic, service benefit, or patient question first. The brand name and location come after a few words.
approved_formats: How [Service] Can Help Restore Your Smile at Great Lakes Family Dental in [Location]
What To Know About [Topic] at Great Lakes Family Dental in [Location]
When Should You Consider Visiting a Dentist at Great Lakes Family Dental in [Location]?
Signs You May Need [Service] at Great Lakes Family Dental in [Location]
When [Patient Concern] Needs Attention at Great Lakes Family Dental in [Location]
avoid_formats: Great Lakes Family Dental Provides Dental Care in [Location]
Great Lakes Family Dental in [Location] Explains [Topic]
Great Lakes Family Dental Offers [Service] in [Location]
title_rules.rule_note: The title should feel helpful and patient-first, not brand-first.

brand_name_usage.rule: Always use the FULL public-facing brand name 'Great Lakes Family Dental in [Location]' in all patient-facing content. Do NOT use 'Great Lakes Dental', 'Great Lakes', or any shortened form in posts.
brand_name_usage.critical_note: The correct brand name is 'Great Lakes Family Dental' — NOT 'Great Lakes Dental'. Using the wrong name is a brand compliance failure.
examples: Great Lakes Family Dental in Howell
Great Lakes Family Dental in Livonia, MI
Great Lakes Family Dental in Saginaw

must_do: Explain the service or topic in simple language
Mention the patient concern or benefit
Introduce the brand and location naturally
intro_guidelines.example_service: Dental implants can help restore the look and function of a natural tooth. At Great Lakes Family Dental in Howell, patients can learn about implant options designed to support long-term oral health. The dental team provides guidance focused on comfort, oral health, and long-term smile care.
intro_guidelines.example_topic: Dental concerns are easier to manage when they are addressed early. At Great Lakes Family Dental in Howell, patients can receive care for routine dental visits, ongoing discomfort, and urgent oral health needs in a comfortable setting.

service_post_structure.description: For service-based posts (treatment_focused, service_focused post themes)
sections_in_order: Title: topic/benefit-first, brand name and location after a few words
Short Intro: 2-3 sentences explaining the service and why it matters
Benefits Section: 5 to 6 bullet points, introduced with '[Service] may help with:'
Procedure / Process Section: what the patient can expect — initial evaluation, review of oral health, personalized recommendation, treatment planning, comfort-focused care
Why Choose Great Lakes Family Dental? section
CTA: Book or Schedule an appointment with Great Lakes Family Dental in [Location]

non_service_post_structure.description: For educational, symptom-based, or awareness posts (educational, seasonal, family_lifestyle, smile_maintenance, conversion_focused, local_trust_building post themes)
sections_in_order: Short Intro: 2-3 sentences explaining why the topic matters
Signs / Tips / Reasons Section: bullet points for symptoms, warning signs, or tips
Why Choose Great Lakes Family Dental? section

why_choose_section.heading: Why Choose Great Lakes Family Dental?
must_highlight: Care for routine and urgent dental needs
why_choose_section.example: Great Lakes Family Dental in [Location] provides preventive, restorative, cosmetic, pediatric, orthodontic, and emergency dental care in a supportive environment. Patients can get help for routine visits, ongoing concerns, and urgent dental needs.

cta_rules: End every post with a clear, appointment-focused CTA. Mention the brand name and location. Use 'Book an appointment' or 'Schedule an appointment'. Keep it short and action-focused. Avoid phone numbers unless specifically required.
cta_examples: Book your dental appointment with Great Lakes Family Dental in [Location] today.
Schedule an appointment with Great Lakes Family Dental in [Location] today.
Schedule your visit with Great Lakes Family Dental in [Location] today.

tone.description: Warm, helpful, patient-first, simple, reassuring, and locally approachable
tone.avoid: Too sales-heavy, too clinical, too robotic, fear-based, or overly promotional
good_phrases: Dental concerns are easier to manage when they are addressed early.
Our team will review your oral health before recommending treatment.
Your comfort and oral health are always part of the conversation.
A timely visit can help protect your smile.

educational.description: Explaining dental concerns, symptoms, prevention, or oral health basics
must_include: Why it should not be ignored

seasonal.description: Connect the season or holiday to oral health naturally

treatment_focused.description: Explain a treatment in a simple, benefit-led way

family_lifestyle.description: Relatable content for parents, children, and busy households

local_trust_building.description: Build local relevance and patient confidence in the office
must_include: How the office supports local patients

smile_maintenance.description: Ongoing oral health habits and preventive care

must_include: Why now is a good time to schedule

service_focused.description: Highlight a specific dental service clearly and directly
must_include: What the service is used for

pre_publish_checklist: Title does NOT start with the brand name
Brand name appears after a few words in the title
Full brand name 'Great Lakes Family Dental' used — NOT 'Great Lakes Dental' or 'Great Lakes'
Intro briefly explains the service or topic in 2-3 sentences
Service posts include a benefits section with 5-6 bullets
Service posts include a procedure or process section
Every post includes a 'Why Choose Great Lakes Family Dental?' section
CTA uses 'Book an appointment' or 'Schedule an appointment'
Brand name and location are used naturally throughout
Tone is helpful, clear, and patient-friendly
Post is within the 1500 character limit

allowed: Images relevant to the post topic
not_allowed: Overly clinical or graphic dental procedure images
Images that may cause anxiety in patients

formatting_rules: Ideal length: 1300-1450 characters for detailed posts
Title must be topic/benefit-first — never brand-first
Use bullet points for benefits, symptoms, tips, or process steps
Every post must include a 'Why Choose Great Lakes Family Dental?' section
Must end with a closing CTA using 'Book' or 'Schedule an appointment'
No banned phrases or guarantee language
